T:P1.1.text: American Public Education, Inc. | Investor Relations

T:P2.1.text: American Public Education, Inc. | About Us - Overview

T:P2.2.text: APEI is the largest educator of active-duty military, veterans, and their families, and a leading provider of pre-licensure ADN and PN programs throug

T:P2.3.text: APEI’s American Military University (AMU) was founded with a mission: to serve those who serve. AMU was created to support the unique educational needs of our nation’s military. Today, APEI is the largest educator of active-duty military and veterans, and a leading provider of pre-licensure ADN and PN programs through Rasmussen University and Hondros College of Nursing. APEI remains committed to social responsibility by providing affordable, accessible, and high-quality education in high-demand fields.

T:P2.4.text: Today, APEI offers a portfolio of education solutions:

T:P2.5.text: American Military University, a leading provider of fully online higher education to active duty servicemembers, veterans, and their families

T:P2.6.text: American Public University, a top choice for working professionals seeking a higher education fully online that fits their lives

T:P2.7.text: Hondros College of Nursing, specializing in quick pathways for practical nursing, ADN, and medical assisting, educates students online and in person at campuses in Ohio, Indiana, and Michigan

T:P2.8.text: Rasmussen University, a national leader in nursing education and serves students across the U.S. online, and at campus locations throughout Minnesota, Illinois, North Dakota, Kansas, and Florida

T:P2.9.text: Our mission is to power purpose, potential, and prosperity for those in service to others. We’re guided by four main pillars: Affordability, Quality, Innovation, and Outcomes-Focused Learning.

T:P2.11.text: Students enrolled across all education units*

T:P2.12.text: For us, affordability promotes access. Through our commitment to keeping tuition rates low without sacrificing academic excellence, we boost access to higher education, so more students are able to realize their goals and derive true value for their investment.

T:P2.13.text: We ensure quality by maintaining a focus on academic excellence—delivered by practitioner faculty who enrich learning with their real-world expertise from business, government, healthcare, public safety, law enforcement, and the military.

T:P2.14.text: We believe the more than 350,000 students and alumni who have trusted us to advance their knowledge serve as proof of our commitment to quality. Accreditation by recognized and respected agencies, including institutional accreditation from the Higher Learning Commission (HLC) for American Public University System, and select programs at our Academic Units holding programmatic accreditation, further signals our quality and commitment to academic rigor.

T:P2.15.text: APEI seeks to drive innovation in education technology. We began as American Military University, offering distance education for our nation’s servicemembers, putting us among the earliest fully online educators.

T:P2.16.text: We continue to evolve our educational approach by integrating relevant technology and fostering innovative learning practices that prepare students with the skills that employers value most.

T:P2.17.text: Our campus-based programs, focused primarily on nursing and healthcare education, also embrace innovation through the use high-quality simulation labs and other hands-on learning methods.

C:P1.2.text: Help future-proof your workforce with scalable learning solutions that leverage 130+ years of adult education and 20+ years of employer partnerships.

C:P1.3.text: Strategic Education, Inc. is leading the charge for modern, future-proof learning

C:P1.4.text: With roots in education that span more than a century, we know where learning has been and we’re shaping where it’s going next.

C:P1.6.text: Customize your choices. From our wholly owned tuition assistance platform to accredited degrees, non-degree skill pathways, coding schools and more.

C:P1.7.text: Together, we’ll create a dynamic learning environment where every role has the potential to evolve and every learned skill opens new doors.

C:P1.8.text: Our mission drives everything we do.

C:P1.9.text: Our latest developments and media coverage.

C:P1.10.text: Transforming education requires highly talented people.

C:P2.1.text: About - Company Info - Our Mission, Strategic Education, Inc.

C:P2.2.text: Strategic Education, Inc. is dedicated to enabling economic mobility with education.

C:P2.3.text: With a focus on improving college affordability, student engagement, and workforce readiness, we are supporting the growing majority of nontraditional students and ensuring that our graduates have the skills required to succeed in today’s jobs.

C:P2.4.text: For an overview of our business, see our Company Profile.

C:P3.1.text: Degrees and Certificates From Strayer University and Capella University | Universities

C:P3.2.text: Give employees affordable, flexible degree and certificate programs built for working adults—find job-relevant options in healthcare, IT, business and more.

C:P3.3.text: Our accredited universities prioritize accessibility to high-quality education for working adults, offering flexible pricing options, including tuition-covered pathways.

C:P3.4.text: Level the playing field with tuition-covered degree options

C:P3.5.text: Strayer University and Capella University proudly offer Tuition Assistance Aligned Pricing (TAAP), aligning the cost of select degrees to match the annual dollar amount of your education benefit, meaning no out-of-pocket tuition cost for your employees.

C:P3.6.text: Strayer University also offers Degrees@Work—a fixed-fee tuition model that provides employers with a predictable, annual investment while giving employees access to fully covered courses and degree programs.

C:P3.7.text: Capella University: advanced online degrees for the modern world

C:P3.8.text: Empower your team with bachelor’s, master’s and doctoral programs that prioritize their time via flexible learning formats—allowing learners to earn their degrees on their terms.

C:P3.10.text: Innovative learning formats: FlexPath, where learners proceed at their own pace, and GuidedPath, which offers more structure.

C:P3.11.text: Professionally aligned degrees that can help students meet current and future challenges in their chosen field.

C:P3.12.text: Programs that are competency-based and designed for working professionals to provide immediately applicable skills.

C:P3.13.text: Support for every step of your learners’ academic journey, from enrollment to graduation.

C:P3.14.text: Provide your workforce with the flexibility they need to pursue higher education. Capella's groundbreaking FlexPath learning format, available in select programs, allows employees to customize their learning experience and pursue their goals on their own terms.

C:P3.15.text: Work and learn at the same time: Your employees can take one or two courses at a time.
